brief: No bald playable characters. Distinct protagonist silhouettes inspired by JoJo's dramatic character design while retaining sculptural divinity.
common: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a major redesign of an original playable ancient philosopher protagonist for an isometric browser game. Art direction: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure inspired theatrical protagonist energy — extravagant distinctive hair, dramatic high-fashion silhouette, heroic proportions, sculpted musculature, confident body language and luxurious statement accessories — combined with museum-quality ivory marble, antique gold and jewel-toned enamel. Original character, not an existing anime character. This is a beautifully rendered living classical statue with striking colored stone/enamel garments, NOT a generic old man in plain toga, not a background NPC. FULL THICK HEAD OF HAIR: absolutely no bald crown, receding hairline, thinning hair, shaved head or exposed scalp anywhere, including corrupted forms. Readable silhouette at 128px. Fine tactile carved surfaces and realistic dimensional lighting, not flat cel animation. IMPORTANT output: FOUR poses of exactly the same character, in EXACT equally sized 2-column x 2-row grid on square 2048x2048 canvas, all four entirely isolated on true transparent alpha. Each figure centered in its own cell, entire hair/outfit/feet visible with at least 12% clear margin from EVERY cell edge. Same scale and costume in all cells. Top-left IDLE: stylish, self-assured contrapposto, one hip cocked, shoulders turned, head slightly glancing toward camera. Top-right RUN-A: left knee leading, right foot trailing, opposite arm swing. Bottom-left RUN-B: right knee leading, left foot trailing, opposite arm swing, clearly opposite step from RUN-A. Bottom-right JUMP: both knees bent beneath body, one arm lifted for balance, garment following movement. All poses face/travel northeast (upper right), viewed from back-left three-quarter isometric angle with camera elevated30 degrees, sufficient profile face visible. Idle and run feet near same baseline within each cell. Characters remain humanoid adults with normal two arms/two legs, no pedestal. Directional upper-left lighting. Background fully transparent, character body and clothing completely opaque, no fog, shadows, ground, grid lines, labels, text, letters, watermarks, extra figures or extra weapons. Hair and costume must be consistent across all four cells.

characters.name: Socrates
characters.subject: SOCRATES — THE DEFIANT QUESTIONER. A heroic mature adult man with broad muscular shoulders, strong jaw, expressive arched brows, a neatly sculpted SHORT beard, and a magnificent FULL thick lionlike mane of swept-back layered ivory hair. Hair is voluminous over the entire crown and forms a bold spiky swept-back silhouette; a few thick locks frame the face. A spectacular asymmetrical deep EMERALD GREEN stone-enamel sash crosses his ivory torso and becomes a short windswept shoulder cape; muscular arms visible. Tailored knee-length ivory battle chiton, wide antique-gold belt with a LARGE circular sun buckle, enormous elegant fluted gold forearm bracers, gold knee guards and sturdy strapped Greek boots. Geometric laurel details only. Broad triangular strongman silhouette, unstoppable charisma and rebellious philosopher confidence. Emerald fabric occupies at least one third of outfit and is obvious from back/side. Signature idle pose: one hand at hip, chin lifted, opposing shoulder rolled forward. No horns in divine form.

characters.name: Plato
characters.subject: PLATO — THE ARCHITECT OF IDEALS. A tall statuesque handsome adult man, elegant broad chest tapering to narrow waist, CLEAN SHAVEN sharp face, a FULL head of thick long pearl-ivory sculpted hair with a dramatic high swept wave at the forehead, luxurious flowing locks down to shoulder blades. Absolutely full crown. A fitted high-collared LAPIS BLUE stone-enamel sleeveless long coat with two long sharply separated split tails reaching to mid-calf, ivory fitted classical leggings, tall gold-trimmed boots; a gold geometric sunburst shoulder brooch and a rigid narrow gold sash at the waist. One pronounced angular layered gold shoulder ornament, the other shoulder simpler, a small elegant blue mantle. Ancient Greek motifs reinterpreted as flamboyant sculptural couture; no modern zippers, no writing. Lapis coat occupies half silhouette. Long vertical elegant silhouette, poised visionary, aristocratic swagger. Signature idle pose: hand raised thoughtfully near chin, opposite hand held behind back, sweeping coat tail.

characters.name: Aristotle
characters.subject: ARISTOTLE — THE RELENTLESS SEEKER. A lean athletic adult man with strong compact proportions, clean sharply defined cheekbones, very short sculpted chin beard, and a FULL head of thick dark antique-BRONZE curls gathered into a high sculptural curly topknot, with abundant curly fringe and two long curled face-framing locks. Full unshaved sides, full hair covering the whole scalp, no receding hairline. Cropped BURGUNDY red stone-enamel scholar's jacket with a large dramatic diagonal collar and short angular shoulder panels, ivory fitted tunic beneath, layered angular knee-length panels over fitted ivory trousers, slim antique-gold wrist guards, gold-trimmed boots. A large angular diamond-shaped gold belt buckle and two dramatic narrow burgundy ribbonlike mantle tails reaching to knees. Burgundy occupies at least one third of silhouette. Agile compact silhouette, energetic daring genius; lighter outfit than the other heroes. Signature idle pose: one hand pointing outward at shoulder height, other resting at waist, bold contrapposto.
